Commentary: Nayeem Hasan to Amir Jangoo, no run, full outside off, driven to extra cover
Another visit from the Bangladesh physio! He's been busy in this session and it's the keeper who wants his attention again. No urgency from the players to get on with it.

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Kavem Hodge, no run, now a blow to the leg for Litton Das and there comes the physio once more! Lost count how many visits he's had to the middle in this session. Down the leg-side, he looks to sweep and drags it off the under-edge onto Das's left foot

The spray being used to numb the pain. Das gets up with a limp and is now inspecting his foot. West Indies coach Sammy is making some gestures from the balcony aimed at the Bangladesh players. All in good fun. Meanwhile, the entire pitch is now under shadows

We'll have to wait and see how West Indies approach things tomorrow. They'd probably want to take any chance of a Bangladesh win out of the equation before declaring on a pitch that is still holding up quite well. There's more turn on offer but it's slow turn, allowing batters enough time to adjust. A draw seems the likely result at this stage but who knows. Can never predict how a fourth innings on a final day can go. That's it for now. Goodbye!
